name: Hearts Faster Than Light - Christmas Special
source:
A cute little hallmark esc Christmas special!

In this special, you will find Dawn and crews in their most unfamiliar setting yet... modern day!!! It's all the weird queer furries with all their secrets and drama, but like, nobody is gonna be thrown out into the vacuum of space!
translation:
可爱的小标志esc圣诞特辑！

在这个特别节目中，你会发现黎明和船员们处于他们最陌生的环境中……现代！！！这些都是奇怪的怪异毛茸茸的人，有他们的秘密和戏剧性，但是，没有人会被扔到太空的真空中！
